task: Yes, <Ranger>, we've got some job for you! You see, our colleagues headed for planet <ToPlanet> of the <ToStar> system to participate in amateur Clerks without End competitions. Sounds stupid of course, but for us, simple office employees, these competitions mean a lot. Well, alright. This is still not what I want you to do. The point is that our guys do not understand a thing about sport (they were selected by casting lots). They surely need to have a trainer, but due to red tape delays we failed to hire anyone.  Now, you must have understood what I am driving at, we propose that you occupy yourself in moving our guys to victory. Don't show me a face like that - you, rangers, are so audacious and athletic. Why do you shake you head - I saw this in a stereomovie! To sum it up, if you manage to lead our team to first place, we will pay you a compensation of <Money> cr. Yeah! But only for fist place, and not just any place. Moreover, they will wait for you only until <Date>. So what? Will you do that?
success: Here he is! <Ranger> - the winner! From the Ranger Negotiations Department to the winner - hip-hip-hurrah! Well, we finally out-pointed them upstarts from the <ToPlanet> planet. Yep! We finished the celebration only yesterday. We almost drank your bonus, oops, almost used your bonus to cope with an emergency situation. But I managed to stop that before action was taken. The agreement is the agreement. So, as agreed I transfer <Money> cr to your bank account.
loc.1.0:
Blue airbus was flying fast somewhere up ahead, weaving from one air corridor to another. You could see the sights of the mega-polis in the window: neon lights glinting with aqua colours, suspended bridges with walkers small as ants, going on their business, sunbeams trying hard to get to these city levels. You have already seen this many times before. But in spite of this, the scenery was very pleasant to your weary ranger's eyes.

A multicolour booklet suddenly came in sight, it was lying in the plastic reading box in front of you. You started to scan through it having nothing better to do:
"Clerks without End - the competitions of office employees, second in scope only to the Olympics. Clerks and office employees in an atmosphere of sport competition which is alien to them, sudden revealing of talents - these are the main features that attract the attention of hundreds of billion of spectators to this event... As usual, the championship will consist of five classic sports and the Marathon which is changing from time to time..."
A usual booklet. Or, maybe it's better to ready it more attentively?
loc.7.0:
Suddenly, the airbus reduced speed and landed at a small blacktop platform. The passengers started taking their baggage and getting out into the street quickly like hit balls. Noting that, you took your small belongings and also left the airbus fast. 

You've reached your destination. In front of you is a huge skyscraper of a strange octagonal form with a sign at the top saying "Prism Paradise". According to your data, here is where your trainees stay. 

You were talking with them within five minutes already. All future contestants that were entrusted to your care turned out to be short. But who knows, maybe they have got some latent talents? Continuing the conversation with such a pleasant company you learned that their names were <clr>Ashot, Bibik, Cutter, Domer and Elfer<clrEnd>. One of those smart sportsmen told you that in fifteen minutes <clr>the whole team will have to go downstairs for a briefing<clrEnd> or something like that.
loc.8.0: You made it fast to the hotel on one of the last airbuses. Merrily discussing the day, all your company occupied their rooms and sat down on the sofas. Tomorrow will be a hard day. You should be very well prepared to it.

loc.10.0: - So, what sport do we want to test? - a Peleng asked you, gaping with self-satisfaction.
loc.10.1:
You very quickly found the Peleng responsible for familiarising newcomers with sporting equipment at the site and headed for the gym.

Having switched on all the equipment, the Peleng asked you tiresomely:
- What competition type will we test today?
loc.10.2:
A tough Peleng in sporting outfit waited for you downstairs. Having approached you he started to say:
- Hello, contestants! My name is Tsvacek. I will be your guide today. Please follow me...
The Peleng took a lot of time introducing you to the neighbourhood, showing you where the laundrette, Chinese restaurant and barber's shop were located.  He walked you through picturesque alleys, telling stories from the history of the city and even showed you a monument to the great Chvakher, who killed the last Klissan in the <ToStar> system. 

In the evening Tsvacek led you to the sports complex where the championship will take place.
- Know what, - the Peleng said. - <clr>You can try all the five sports<clrEnd> that will be presented at the championship. They are: wrestling, swamp games, energy modelling, encyclopaedic and Iike-Baana. According to the procedures, the number of the sparrings at sporting equipment is limited, so you have a total of [p13] <clr>runs-up<clrEnd>. And what I understand by run-up is the following: you quickly put on competition outfit, get to one of the competition simulators, and I quickly conduct the competition as a referee. You know the time is late already. <clr>You can postpone several of your competition sparrings for subsequent evenings.<clrEnd>

You headed for the Gym. Having switched on all equipment the Peleng tiresomely asked you:
- What competition type do you wish to test?

loc.47.0:
In the morning, after having a bite you brushed yourself up and left the hotel together with your team. The airbus transferred you to your destination very quickly. Having found the contestants' seats, you sat down quickly.

- Today is the <clr>Wrestling Day<clrEnd>. No. Not some trifling Sumo. The real Rartan Maloq fighting! - someone's voice was spreading across the huge sporting complex, packed to the max by a motley crowd. - Today we here present will see who is the strongest in this ancient sport. In the times when the Faeyans have not yet devised the stereovision, the Great Rartan was already winning over his...

The voice continued to tell about today's activities. You and your magnificent five were sitting yawning on the bench near the action field, waiting for it to begin. There was nothing special to do, and you occupied yourself observing the pretty girls in the front rows. Finally a spiny person in a cap with a lightning emblem came to you and asked to name your contestant for today's competition.
loc.47.1:
You spent much time trying to wake up your trainees. But you coped with it. Washing, breakfast, and your are already going down in the elevator. 

Having reached the sport complex and showed your tiny badges, you found yourself inside the main arena without any trouble and headed for the contestants' seats. 

In the middle of the arena there was already a dozen of swamps prepared. People in canvass-latex suits were plunging some instruments into the water and were making some notes in watertight minicomps. The check of the mudding level was on to comply with the Galaxy standards. The oval plasmoscreen under the ceiling showed the sign: <clr>"Plumpush Day - Peleng swamping contest"<clrEnd>. 

Arrived at the place you came up to one of the receptionists to tell the name of a contestant on behalf of your team. The clerk took off a transparent plasmopen, gleaning with a bluish light from inside, and prepared to listen to you.
loc.47.2:
You waked up your trainees in the morning and, after necessary washing and breakfast, you dragged them energetically to the competitions.

Approaching the main arena you have noticed a large hologram, spinning above the snow-white dome - "<clr>Energy Modelling Day<clrEnd>" - the hologram was made in beautiful orange-yellow shades. The organisers placed a large energy sculpture of an angel delicately spreading wings inside of the building. Commentator voice was spreading across the huge hall. You gave ear to what it said:

- When the great Human architect Aquadan Matisse created his work of genius - the sculpture of an angel, the remake of which is in our hall now, the world realised that a new art was born, as monumental as pathograthy and chemical reaction poetry. Yes. The Humans once again proved their reputation as the most creative nation of the Galaxy Commonwealth. But the most impressive thing is that energy work cannot be cloned faultlessly, unlike the situation in visual arts, architecture and pathograthy, where it is very easy. The problem is the unstableness of energy under the impact of...

You got sick and tired of hearing all that, therefore you got completely buried in your own thoughts on the way to the contestants' seats. Finally you and your company reached the destination and started a conversation with the receptionist who was trying to learn who will contest in energy modelling on behalf of your team. Well. Whom will you designate?..
loc.47.3:
Morning rays of the <ToStar> star are harsh for your eyes, but, stepping over yourself, you woke up your magnificent five and dragged them to the competitions. 

Having reached the sport complex without any problems, you reached into the main arena building, getting trough the crowded passageways. On your way you had to tolerate the most dreary of commentators, who was covering today's events, because you just had no way of getting away from that voice:

- Today we interview a renowned encyclopaedist, laureate, winner of several championships and - simply a good Faeyan - dalani Samimurakami. Mister Sami, why the encyclopaedic takes its origins from you, the Faeyans?
- This is no secret, - another dreary voice appeared, - that we honour knowledge. The one who possesses knowledge possesses the world. You know. Well, take a hamburger, for instance, can you start eating it, knowing nothing about its biochemical composition, its cooking procedure, conservation, its history - to mention just a few things? Right you are, you cannot. And that's how things stand absolutely with all things. 
- Fine. But let's get back to our subject. What do you think, will this <clr>Encyclopaedic Day<clrEnd> be successful?
- Naturally, today's contest does not interest me as a specialist. But as an individual I will be interested in hearing stupid answers of the bulk of, well, of all the competitors, if you have it. This competition is not professional... And do you recall the question on the number of Machpella's eyes?..

Suddenly someone grabbed you by the hand. You woke up from trans. 
- Who will be taking part in the Ecyclopaedica on behalf of your team? - the receptionist inquired.
loc.47.4:
You made some callisthenics in the morning, having made a couple of push-ups. After that you headed to wake up your fighters. Having made quick preparations, you and all your team got down to hotel's lobby...

The airbus was approaching the sport complex, but the pilot chose not to get down, but made special flight above and around the huge arena, demonstrating it to the passengers. The whole dome of the gigantic building was spangled with millions of speckled and dappled flowers that were dangling in the wind, resembling an ocean during slight breeze. In the middle of a composition of flamed flowers a sign read "<clr>Gaalian Iike-Baana Day<clrEnd>".
Aerobus touched down soon, and you, headed for the entrance with all your trainees, greatly impressed by what you saw.
Everything was also decorated with an incredible amount of flowers inside, they put in spirals and hanging just above spectators' heads throughout the hall. In the middle, on the main platform, the table was already set and ready for hot fighting of the intellects. 

Gazing at all this beauty and thus constantly bumping at passers-by, you made it to the contestants' seats and even managed to find the receptionist without any trouble. So, who will fight today this intellectual battle?

- Not quite. I am a trainer. At least for today.
- Wow! What a coincidence. I am a trainer myself, I mean - the breeder. I breed penchekryaks. And sometimes not only penchekryaks, - the huge guy roared a good laugh.

So, whom it's best to send for the artist's lesson?

And really whom?

- Deal. Take your buddy and get here. I have everything ready.

So who will you select for the treatment?

- And what I am talking about? Hit him in the kidney. No team will face up to good hatching. By the way, who are you? Have I seen you someplace? - the Peleng said noticing you at last.
- I am a trainer of one of the team, - you said.
- Wow! And I am a trainer. And not just a trainer, but the trainer of the Wild Fruggiesss team. The discovery of hatch-ball season of the year before last! 

Your face showed admiration and deference, although you have heard absolutely nothing about a team like that, it was present neither in the major nor in the higher leagues. 

- I have been awarded a letter of acknowledgement of the third degree for a special training method: "Scoop and Win". <clr>A very effective method for training strength and craftiness<clrEnd>. And this is the main thing in hatch-ball. You know...
- If you are so good a trainer could you somehow whip my team into shape? 
- A team - no. The method will not work... I could've trained one person perhaps, you know. But I am a professional, I don't work for free. But as you are my colleague, I will not charge you high, say, some <clr>150<clrEnd> cr.
loc.93.1: - How they are bred? Tenderly, - the Maloq laughed once again. - First feed the critter to repletion with one supplement, then the other. Well, why am I telling you this. You will not understand it anyway. Better hear this. I am here for the annual Best Breeders Forum. And I also brought here my new supplement - Yum-Yum. It increases penchekryaks' <clr>IQ level<clrEnd>, but that's not all, it also works on Humans and Maloqs. I nourish my wife with this supplement, so that she saves more money. And - can you believe me - it works! Honestly, she <clr> loses some strength<clrEnd>, but she is not supposed to carry penchekrayks that weight some 500 kg. Dig that? Well, I somehow guess that you do not... You would benefit from my supplement. What? Alright, I'll charge only the base price - <clr>30<clrEnd> cr.
loc.94.0: - Yes. I am a maniac. By my mania is science. I am its servant, eternal slave. And concerning the stereo-programs... Know what, I do not watch them. So how about taking part? <clr>The deal about 20 cr remains in force!<clrEnd>
loc.94.1: - I am the developer of the general knowledge testing system. Therefore, my experiments consist of testing my testing system on all the beings. So what about my proposal on taking part in my experiment?

loc.110.0:
"PREREQUISITES FOR SELECTING COMPETITION TYPES":
The scholars all over the world agree that the <clr>main contestant characteristics are - strength, craftiness, creative capabilities, knowledge and IQ<clrEnd>. Based on that we selected the <clr>corresponding<clrEnd> five classic competition types: Rartan wrestling, Plumpush - Swamping games, Energy Modelling, Encyclopedica and Iike-Baana. If a competitor possesses the aforementioned qualities, he will gain success. 

It's noteworthy, by the way, that the capabilities, used in one classic sport <clr>provide absolutely no impact<clrEnd> on other classic types. As a matter of course this rule does not apply in marathon, because of the interfacing character of the competitions. Moreover, <clr>in marathon competitions the low level of one of the competition characteristics will lead to rather bad overall performance, even if the level of the other characteristic would be substantially high<clrEnd>. For instance, if we take the air bats, you cannot win this game only by sheer force. You must use craftiness frequently, otherwise a strong sportsman will be outplayed by his more crafty opponents.

Another important factor is the competitors' fatigue. <clr>Even a most talented but tired sportsman can be knocked down by a mediocre opponent who is in good form <clrEnd>. Yep. <clr>half<clrEnd> tired sportsman will be performing <clr> two times<clrEnd> worse than that who had a 100 percent rest. And very tired one will show no result at all. Therefore all trainers, when the time of the competition is approaching, are trying to give their sportsmen some rest, so that they could restore after the trainings..."

...this section was further describing philosophic aspects of each of the competition types, but you skipped it. 

TEAM ORGANIZATION:
The teams are organised by the computer based on all-embracing week-long testing of the aspirants. As the result <clr>the competitors are randomly selected but so that the sums of team's abilities be equal<clrEnd>. For example, if three team member lack any abilities in, say, creative work, the remaining two will necessarily be able (and maybe just one, but in this case he has to be smashingly talented.). The same thing concerns all the competitive characteristics. 

WHO WINS:
In each of the classical sport the competitor can score <clr> up to 15 points<clrEnd>, that are placed in the team's collective hoard. The competitor can also wing <clr>no more than 15 points<clrEnd> at each stage of the marathon. Its noteworthy that <clr>as a rule the competitor who possesses more than one talents, required for the competition, and that are on the acceptable level, can win the marathon.<clrEnd>..."

Next was the chronology of the championship and the champion list, after which a huge space was dedicated to some armpit spray ad. You noticed only that the main favourite of this year's competitions is the team of the <ToPlanet> planet. 

"I should follow their performance very closely", - you said to yourself.

- Who would perch out here? The arena is closed. Sitting here at that hour is proscribed!!!
Looking back you noticed a bearded man in a winter earflap hat with a hydraulic broom in his hands, who was running in your direction. Turning to the seats of your trainees you saw none of them there, for they were running to the exit already. You were not hesitant in following suit - considering that when a hydraulic broom bumps your head it will not be perfectly inappropriate.

Within half an hour you were heading to your hotel in a comfortable airbus.

jump.215.desc:
- A bold Maloq by Snicker - yes, that a magnificent sculpture work. But don't forget about the Lame Peleng by the Humster Horsegrove. And how nice is the Galatea with a tachyon cutter...
You talked with the artist for several hours about the art, cultural disintegration of the nation, and on the general strengthening of one's body by means of urinal therapy. When the morning came the security asked you to leave civilly. You obeyed. Saying goodbye to the artist, you went to bed.
jump.216.text: You are an artist, I gather. And not bad, it looks. Can teach one of my trainees to create something artistically?
jump.217.text: Don't take anyone. Say goodbye to the artist and get back to your seat
jump.227.desc:
Taking your trainee you easily found the breeder's room. Having paid him the agreed upon amount you placed yourself on a sofa waiting for the events to develop. At last the Maloq dragged a barrel and a huge scoop. Seeing these instruments, your trainee rushed to the door. It was closed. He rushed to the window, but then the Maloq gripped your sportsman professionally by the scruff. 
- Where d'ya think your goin'? You are not fed yet. 
He started to regale you protégé.
- This one's for the daddy, this one's for the mommy, this one's for the Yam-Yam bush, - the Maloq was saying feeding your trainee with a greenish fluid.
The Maloq's actions were slow, so that the ... foodstuff would digest well. Therefore the treatment ended only in a couple of hours. Your trainee crumpled to the sofa, his strength left him. Surprisingly he started to do some arithmetic exercise at once. 
- Look here. <clr>He grew wiser.<clrEnd> And what I was saying. This is an alright slop. <clr>He will lose some strength though<clrEnd>. Has been tested. And no he needs to get fast into his stall. I mean to the room. He's got to digest it properly. 
Saying this, the Maloq showed you the door. Well, it was nothing doing. You had to drag your well-fed fighter to the team's headquarters.
jump.228.desc:
Agreed upon everything with the Faeyan you visited him in his room together with your trainee. The testing took quite a time. During all this period you were closely following the process, sitting in a soft terry cloth armchair. You were being caught by the slumber, but the constant beeping of the Faeyan' computer was raising you up. 

The morning came, and the first rays of the <ToStar> star were getting inside through the jalousie, being pleasant to the eye. Looking at this spectacle you understood that the testing ended. 
- Alright, - the Faeyan said. - The experiment is completed. Now I will got to sleep.
- And what about the result?! - you shouted suddenly.
- Well, do you need it that bad? OK, I'll tell you. According to the results of my testing, <clr>the general IQ of your protégé is <clrEnd> {(([p18] div 100 mod 100)>=8)*60+(([p18] div 100 mod 100)<8)*(([p18] div 100 mod 100)*6+(1 to 6))} <clr>out of 60<clrEnd>. But you should take it into account, that the testing is not approbated yet, there is some inaccuracy, inexactitude of the results. But <clr>for my system it is not important whether the tested being is tired or not <clrEnd>. OK. Now its time to get to bed. 

The Faeyan gave you the agreed upon <clr>20<clrEnd> cr, helped you to the exit and went to sleep. You and your sportsman were not slow to follow suit. You went into your room to sleep the remaining hours.
jump.230.desc:
Having determined the trainee you gave the money to the trainer. 

Within fifteen minutes you were staying near a swamp, located at the back of the hotel. A boisterous Peleng armed himself with a long stick and ordered your protégé to duck into the muddy guck. After this he started to pierce him with that same stick. At first the poor trainee was constantly getting it in the ribs but soon your fighter <clr>started to act with more craftiness<clrEnd>, and now the trainer was missing him frequently. But in general the training affected your protégé for the swimming in the Peleng swamp required <clr>good physical training<clrEnd>. When at last the morning came and the Peleng finished the training, you and your trainee that exhausted to the max went to your rooms.
jump.232.desc:
Having found your trainee, you cancelled all his missions for today and took him to the "artist cell". The artist was busy with you was protégé for several hours. All this time you were looking at how the member of the artistic intelligentsia tried to drub into the clerk's head something useful, demonstrating him different work of arts and various drawing and sculpture making techniques. Looked like your trainer already knew many elementary tricks, which caused a great deal of admiration on the part of the artist. 

Finally the artist said:
- Your trainee is not so bad - for a clerk I mean, - he said. - I could not teach him that many things in such a short time. But he <clr>learned a thing or two<clrEnd> and now is more enlighten in the arts. 

Interesting, but it looked like the tired out artist conked out as soon as he uttered these words. You left his room on tiptoes.
jump.234.desc:
Having found your trainee, you cancelled all his missions for today and took him to the "artist cell". The artist was busy with you was protégé for several hours. All this time you were looking at how the member of the artistic intelligentsia tried to drub into the clerk's head something useful, demonstrating him different work of arts and various drawing and sculpture making techniques. 

Finally the artist sat down in the chair and put a yellow towel on his head, showing that he is weary:
- Oh, boy, I was doing all that I could, - he uttered. - This unenlightened human has learned many things. <clr>Some headway was definitely made.<clrEnd> Oh. That's all. I need to go to sleep now.

Looks like the artist really conked out. You left his room on tiptoes.
jump.236.text: Looks like the Peleng is frustrated
jump.237.text: Go in the direction of the Peleng
jump.238.text: Bad, bad, bad. What d'ya think your doing?! Think first, than kick. And not just the air, get it in his kidney, in his kidney!!!
jump.239.text: No. For me its too expensive. I better get back to my place.
jump.241.text: I changed my mind. The training is cancelled. Sorry for the trouble
jump.241.desc:
Strange but the Peleng was not listening to you. He was all kept by the game.
- Go, go, go... G-o-a-l!!!

Not waiting for the reaction of the seasoned trainer, you got back to your place. Good that you haven't given him the money.
jump.242.text: Experiments? Well, and who are you, not a manic of course? I think I saw your hologram in the "Wanted by the Police" stereoprogram.
jump.243.text: I am a member of the Experiment Banning Society. Taking part in such events contradicts the society's charter and my personal moral beliefs. So, please excuse me
jump.244.text: I am a member of the Experiment Banning Society. Taking part in such events contradicts the society's charter and my personal moral beliefs. So, please excuse me
jump.245.desc:
Aikanaut <clr>spent three ours for all-embracing testing of your knowledge <clrEnd>, he asked you various questions and put down the results into a small notebook. Finally, he completed his activity, thanked you for taking part in it, <clr>gave you 20 credits<clrEnd> and headed for the exit.
- And what about the results?! - you shouted to his back.
- You don't really want to know them? I think that would impact your self-esteem. 
Saying this, the scientist decamped, and you were gone to your room.
jump.249.text: I personally do not thirst for taking part myself. But I got several humans that could be of help to you
jump.250.text: Refuse to take part in the experiment and get back to your seat.
jump.251.text: All that you say is very interesting but it is time for me to go
jump.252.text: Penchekryaks? So, how do you breed them?
jump.253.text: Honestly, I don't need that. But there are several candidates who would be greatly moved by such a treatment
jump.254.text: You cannot feed anyone with penchekryak cans - this is banned by the Humanoid Rights Treaty! This will not happen. Good bye.
jump.255.text: Well, know what? We all had good supper tonight, we will not have place for penchekryak food, sorry.
jump.256.text: Make tracks for the be-medalled guy
jump.258.desc:
- Hello! - you said.
- Hi there. I think you do not recognise me. I was known in any shabby village five years ago...
The Maloq started to tell you about his sporting achievements. You were listening to him at first out of courtesy, but soon tried to escape. But the Maloq was always nipping your escape attempts in the bud.
- No. Listen to me. You ain't know nothing. - he was saying amiably grappling you around the neck. Your neck-bones were almost cracking...
The Maloq finished his narrative only in the morning. You have nothing left to do but to get back to your room.
jump.260.desc:
You took up the song with the drunken fat human. Quiet at first, the buddy let himself go and started squalling the song out loud. The security appeared out of nowhere and took the fat man out of the room. Together with you. You started to protest, but they quashed you by the stunner.
You recovered in your room on the morning after. You cannot get back to the recreation room anyway. It's better to sleep the remaining ours...
jump.262.text: Looks like the graviboat has free bear. You have to order a tankard for you
jump.262.desc: The graviboat delivered the free beer to you. Having tried it, you exclaimed that you tasted better. But you would be pleased even with soda water as a freebie. Having finished your drink, you saw that you started to get drunk. Looks like the <clr>brew was too strong<clrEnd>.
jump.269.desc:
Fat man was lying face on the bar.
- I am beeeastly drrrunk again, whooo-whaa, - he announced when you approached him. Then started murmuring something like: - Well shirigim duraham da. Wack for my daddy oh, wack for my astracopter... There's whiskey in the jar.
Having heard a familiar tune you could not restrain yourself from repeating it. Especially in your condition. At first you and the fat buddy were singing the song quietly, but then the buddy let himself go and started squalling the song out loud. The security appeared out of nowhere and took the fat man out of the room. Together with you. You started to protest, but they quashed you by the stanner.

You recovered in your room on the morning after. You cannot get back in time. Its better to sleep the remaining ours...
jump.270.text: Put the pill in the pocket
jump.270.desc: having put the pill in the pocket, you entered the room and got down on the sofa. You were sleeping like that until the morning. As usual for the morning after your had a good headache <clr>but now you have an energine pill in your reserve<clrEnd>.
jump.271.text: Take the pill and go to sleep
jump.271.desc: Having taken the pill, you felt that you were conking out, and merely managed to get to the sofa. But in the morning you were extraordinary vigorous. <clr>The pill took out all the fatigue!<clrEnd> And the hangover effect as well...
jump.272.text: Try to get back to the recreation room
jump.272.desc:
Turning around you went down on the stairs, but could not hold the walls and... Regaining conscience in the morning you barely made it to your room where you slept the remaining hours right on the floor. You had no strength to crawl to the sofa.
Waking up in the morning, <clr>you could not find the pill <clrEnd>. It must have been lost somewhere. <clr>You should put tiny things like this in the pocket.<clrEnd>
jump.286.text: Looks like the graviboat has free bear. You have to order a tankard for you
jump.286.desc:
The graviboat got you the beer another time. You did not want to drink, but the freebie was irresistible... <clr>You conked out<clrEnd> after the fifth sip.

You recovered on the sofa in your room. Thanks God, - security had not pushed you outside, or put in a garbage container, but dragged you here. Having realized that you conked out once again. This time until the morning..
jump.287.text: Send all to sleep, and get down to the recreation hall yourself. (25 cr for a pleasant time spending is a trifle)
jump.288.text: Get back to your room and go to sleep
jump.290.text: Looks like the graviboat has free bear. You have to order a tankard for you
jump.292.desc:
- You have not exhausted you training limit, so you can come tomorrow if you wish, - the Peleng said, helping you to the airbus stop.

Having reached the hotel with no problems, you got inside. Waiting for the elevator you looked around the lobby and saw a double-leaved wooden door with a sign sating: "<clr>Recreation Room<clrEnd>". A tablet was hanging below saying - "Always <clr>free beer<clrEnd> and hatch-ball match broadcasting. Opens at night. <clr>Entrance fee - 25 cr<clrEnd>". You should not this.

Waiting for the elevator you looked around the lobby and saw a double-leaved wooden door with a sign sating: "<clr>Recreation Room<clrEnd>". jump.298.text: Explain the missions to them and then go down to recreation lobby (25 credits for pleasant leisure is an easy expence)
